stage: after main layout, before screenshot review

checks.question: Do pressable controls respond on hover/focus/active/disabled/loading states?
Are keyboard focus states visible, intentional, and consistent?
Are empty, loading, and error states specific to the product instead of generic placeholders?
Does the UI acknowledge user action quickly without fake live/session claims?
Does spacing follow a consistent rhythm instead of arbitrary one-off gaps?
Do numeric/data-heavy areas use tabular alignment where scanning matters?
Does any motion have purpose, correct duration, and reduced-motion behavior?
Do panels, cards, and controls have role-appropriate affordance and not feel like dead rectangles?
Do state transitions avoid layout jank, content jumps, and clipped controls?
